# Where to find and how to farm for pumpkins in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Oct 27, 2022
- 5 min read

Updated: Aug 6, 2023

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cca0fd5836da4b228e469ae50fd0b432~mv2.jpg)

Dedicated to the Halloween Camp Builders. Keep doing amazing and creative things.

This guide was written with player skill level in mind. Some players are not combat ready to take on a Scorchbeast or Super Mutants which is why I have covered all regions on the map.

Pumpkins are used in the following recipes and camp building items:

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dad493affef34bb49be2710681f9d0da~mv2.png)

As with all farming, it is recommended that you run:

- Green Thumb perk card under perception
- Good with Salt perk card under Luck or Refrigerated Backpack (available from Camp Adams vendor machines)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_193a933e386d43f7ba57bf55f8ce6b73~mv2.png)

Pumpkin vines are a fixed spawn. This means that unless you have harvested them recently, they will always be there.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a7b533d8a902497080e1f5ba7573b051~mv2.png)

Keep an eye out for "Verdant Season". This unmarked event is a food buff farmers favourite and makes farming for more difficult ingredients a lot easier.

Verdant season adds a 33% chance for a double yield from any plant within the region that Verdant Season is active in. In layman terms, while this event is active, you have a 33% chance of getting an extra 2 ingredients from every plant that you harvest. This also stacks with the Green Thumb perk card under Perception.

The game doesn't always tell you when it is verdant season. Sometimes you will see a notification on the top left hand side of your screen saying It's a verdant season in (region name here)! Enjoy the abundance! or The verdant season has been extended in the (region name here) or The verdant season in (region name here) has ended. Other times you will just see that you are collecting four ingredients from a plant instead of two.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9521fa4471fa48d19b624c94fe3f4e5d~mv2.jpg)

It is advised that you refresh your pick up history list before going on a pumpkin run.

The easiest way to refresh your pick up history list is to pay a visit to the book house in Summersville. Pick up every single burnt book and text book on all three floors, plus the piles of books on the back table.

You only need to pick up 250 books/items to refresh your pick up history list. There should be a total of 289 books in the book house, but if you pick up everything not bolted down, on all three floors, then you don't need to worry too much if you miss a few burnt books.

There are other ways and places to collect 250 items but the book house is the easiest way because you don't need to keep track of how many items you have picked up.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7258b6e496314451b5e67d04e2fc4678~mv2.png)

### **__Pumpkin Farming Route__**

__Pumpkin Farming Route__

__Full video of the farming route can be found__ __here.__ 

**Pumpkins** - World spawn. Relies on player cell activation and pick up histoy list

**Pumpkin Vines** - Works with Green Thumb perk card. Relies on pick up history list. 

**Aaronholt Homestead**

3x Pumpkins

12x Pumpkin Vines

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d50456b983c3465098e1a3938cfa5ee6~mv2.jpg)

**Morgantown Airport**

6x Pumpkins

7x Pumpkin Vines

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6a9af02546954836a80479578c53d74e~mv2.jpg)

**Unmarked location - Hornwright Estate**

16x Pumpkins

7x Pumpkin Vines

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6a694412021b42e0aced94519c37bf4b~mv2.jpg)

**Unmarked location - Freak Show**

12x Pumpkin Vines

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_622a1d5baf92470490d06c53cf8beed1~mv2.jpg)

**Pumpkin House**

44x Pumpkin Vines

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b4ce70bd88db4455bfd4a658c583675e~mv2.jpg)

**Unmarked location "Halloween Fright Farm" - Pumpkin House**

38x Pumpkins

47x Pumpkin Vines

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f5ab8eae047347c8a64fd550adb4ab55~mv2.jpg)

### **__Pumpkin Pie spawn locations__**

__Pumpkin Pie spawn locations__

For the more casual players, why make pumpkin pie when you can just eat the pre-made ones.

There are 19 external spawn locations for pumpkin pie with an additional 8 internal spawn locations.

External - No load screen to enter

Internal - Load screen needed to enter

Pumpkin Pies rely on player cell activation to spawn. This means that there is a higher chance for the pies to spawn, if there are a lot of players running through and around the area (cell). Public servers are ideal.

**Toxic Dried Lakebed**

External

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ee8988b628224e538fa765218c00e757~mv2.jpg)

Inside Lakeside Grill (diner), on the bench with the register and the teddy bears.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6537eaebca504f07b8ddd4244728a491~mv2.jpg)

**Clarksburg Shooting Club**

External

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0d1227c9827146b2b3ba23eee6866ac7~mv2.jpg)

Face South and run up the mountain in front of you. Climb to the very top and under the large metal power pylon is a tent. Inside the tent on a portable burner is the pie.

ALL HAIL THE PUMPKIN KING!

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_72842a6c40604c028d49b720b0467d95~mv2.jpg)

**Vault 51**

Internal

6x pumpkin pies

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ee4d1c9fa9ec477880961f036e6944e2~mv2.jpg)

**Aaronholt Homestead**

External

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d50456b983c3465098e1a3938cfa5ee6~mv2.jpg)

In the middle house, in the kitchen on the left, inside the oven.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e931dfef6e904321ae5e48465fe4ba81~mv2.jpg)

**Overseer's Home**

Internal

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1a276d1536774c4ea9d0d8ef30048891~mv2.jpg)

Inside the Overseer's home. On the bench, in the kitchen.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9094c3d2f5fc4bcdae3646c0eff6412b~mv2.jpg)

**Bolton Green**

External

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2b65ce1a197945558a1857140cf93cb5~mv2.jpg)

On the road South of Bolton Greens, in the mobile home/trailer, in the oven.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_55eefef878de45d9aed315d4cba28085~mv2.jpg)

**Summersville**

External

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37f49f73304f478e9ad429900abba49e~mv2.jpg)

In the diner, at the far end of the town, closest to New Gad lake. In the kitchen, on the bench.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a3f836f460174563ba30595b0e781794~mv2.jpg)

**Lakeside Cabins workshop**

External

1x pumpkin pie

Check up the road for the rare __baseball bat spawn__ 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9165fdb95bad4baa9439e0fc37d98272~mv2.jpg)

In the main/large two story cabin, closest to the red workshop workbench. In the downstairs kitchen, in the fridge.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0f6f1e69b298453c8039711b317bbf14~mv2.jpg)

**Lewis & Sons (Putnam Residence)**

Internal

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6cc1f452f36c4861a5a64e052462a0e4~mv2.jpg)

Inside the shed (Instanced), in the kitchen, on the corner of the bench.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3500dfc5b3ac4a44806eb0a4717f7ab4~mv2.jpg)

**Sal's Grinders**

External

2x pumpkin pies

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2e2c8ec2d90b4d52bdf1c8597cedae47~mv2.jpg)

First pie, in the diner kitchen, downstairs, in the oven.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c7c7ac982ad147e598feea44e9a90f73~mv2.jpg)

Second pie, in the kitchen, on the bench, near the door.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3ec5d94c027540048ab8f9e899e90d34~mv2.jpg)

**Welsh**

External

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ecef2c0835ac4afd902eb22e093a96f6~mv2.jpg)

House behind the Post Office, downstairs, on the kitchen table.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_520fd09dc6ca4240b87b3c9986c5ba11~mv2.jpg)

**Hornwright Estate**

External

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_045e5ac42f0d48e3a1c5a63405e4576a~mv2.jpg)

Take the elevator up and select "Top Floor". Exit the elevator and take the stairs up on your right. At the top, turn left and walk to the end. Enter the room on your right and the pie will be on the coffee table.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_64e6beae910f492b83b7e9f9ea99a2ac~mv2.jpg)

**Overlook Cabin**

External

2x pumpkin pies

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8cb4ff6376e0433bbf66e0318329f5bb~mv2.jpg)

Downstairs, in the kitchen. One in the oven and the other is on the bench next to the oven.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_742487ce9ba945b19429a37b3069ff0a~mv2.jpg)

**Whitesprings Golf Club**

External

1x pumpkin pie

Check for the three __rare baseball bat spawns__ 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a167333542f442a9b8c744311057edcc~mv2.jpg)

From the front door, stay on the top floor and turn left. Enter the dining area and head towards the kitchen. In the kitchen, in the oven.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3e23348e032f4143b5860ffc49ea2ff0~mv2.jpg)

**Middle Mountain Cabins**

External

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0f9e7844d4164ccc94dcf917d5802160~mv2.jpg)

In the cabin on the far right. On the kitchen table.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_05059382d5ca4f228590cd880d297a11~mv2.jpg)

**Pleasant Valley Cabins**

External

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2e41556383154228bee29f2db0eedf88~mv2.jpg)

From the spawn point, you will see a two story diner on your left. Inside the diner, in the bain marie, on the left hand side of the room.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_215a647662ae43cf878c351dbb8a90f4~mv2.jpg)

**Pumpkin House**

External

2x pumpkin pies

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b4ce70bd88db4455bfd4a658c583675e~mv2.jpg)

Both pies can be found in the downstairs kitchen. One on the kitchen table, and the other is on the bench, in the corner.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2c29afc9402340e7b13d1e706703e6c5~mv2.jpg)

**Harpers Ferry**

External

1x pumpkin pie

Check for the rare __baseball bat spawn__ 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bfd294fc20ab4d8c85ad7c5e976ccec1~mv2.jpg)

From The Burrows North map marker, follow the road down NE. Enter/jump over the first red shipping container gate on your right. A few steps in is a pile of tyres on your left. Jump over the fence at the tyres.

Turn right and look up. You will see a hole in the wall on the second floor. Jump up and into the hole and the pie is on the bench, in the kitchen.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4e3a6a2977ab4dc9b0dd64395390b931~mv2.jpg)

**Sunrise Field**

External

1x pumpkin pie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_84fa2189d989422489c7d95f346b8b51~mv2.jpg)

Inside the house, downstairs, in the kitchen, inside the fridge.
